title: DR-16: rebuilt GroupInfo puts ratchet_tree first
description: mls-ratchet-tree-options-01 §4 does not say where the ratchet_tree extension goes when rebuilding a GroupInfo from a PartialGroupInfo, and the signed bytes depend on it. OpenMLS prepends; mls-rs appends (after external_pub, and before GREASE with its grease feature). Readings: (a) prepend; (b) append. Chosen: (a), matching OpenMLS always and mls-rs whenever ratchet_tree is the only other extension. The case mls-rs exports as [external_pub, ratchet_tree] does not match either way and is untested. wg: noted on mimid-1wgh.37.37.
